items.title: Albert Jiles Interview, 1961-02-24
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] In the picture I think they have Jack Carey and George E. Simms, Papa Solistan, Joe Highwood. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, they.

ctx.x: In Allen's band? No, I don't. No more than Old Man Allen.
In the picture I think they have Jack Carey and George E. Simms, Papa Solistan, Joe Highwood.
